requirements: R1: Clear the 5 failed tasks to unblock the Flow Core from the BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER state

slices.title: Clear failed tasks in Flow Core
slices.jtbd: When implementing the recovery patch for this epic, I want to clear the failed tasks, so that the flow core can resume processing active work.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the system is in BLOCKED_BY_FAILED_FRONTIER state
When the patch to clear failed tasks is executed
Then the failed tasks count is reduced to 0
And the flow core resumes processing live work
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce failed tasks count from 5 to 0
